# Milestone 6 (part): calibration subsample size (generated by summarise.py)

241 cells (source->target pair x item) over 20 pairs; 1172 pair x item x n combinations, each over the run's simple random subsamples. Errors in points of the target's weighted share.

## Variance ratio: the fraction of the plain mean's sample the difference estimator needs

- median var(y - f) / var(y) over cells: 0.830 (pair-cluster bootstrap 95% 0.798 to 0.852); median saving 17%
- cells with ratio < 1: 98%; quartiles 0.732, 0.899
- D RMSE below M RMSE in 96% of pair x item x n combinations

| kind | cells | median ratio | median saving | median n* |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| ethnicity | 13 | 0.853 | 15% | 204 |
| generation | 38 | 0.839 | 16% | 153 |
| period | 46 | 0.826 | 17% | 159 |
| tradition | 144 | 0.818 | 18% | 58 |

## Break-even with the label-free transfer E0

- analytic n* = var(y - f) / b^2: median 91, quartiles 27 to 317; n* < 25 in 23% of cells, > 400 in 22%
- cells whose simulated crossover falls inside the n grid: 137; analytic n* within a factor 2 of it in 99% (median analytic/simulated 0.71)
